_about: Independent synthetic pairs for evaluating near-duplicate detection between company descriptions. 'duplicate' is true when both texts describe the SAME company (one business listed twice), false otherwise. Duplicate kinds: case_whitespace, reworded, reordered, truncated, extra_boilerplate, updated. Non-duplicate kinds: same_business_peer, shared_boilerplate, same_template, same_group_different_unit. Texts are hand-written and all companies are invented; case_whitespace, reordered, truncated and extra_boilerplate apply a mechanical transform to a hand-written base. Splits alternate within each kind; same_business_peer alternates by cluster so a description never appears in both splits. Written without reference to any similarity code.
